permian-triassic-extinction.summary: The most severe extinction event known, eliminating roughly 80% of marine species and clearing the ground for the rise of the dinosaurs.

dinosaur-era.summary: Non-avian dinosaurs dominated terrestrial ecosystems for some 165 million years, from the Late Triassic until the end of the Cretaceous.
dinosaur-era.note: The earliest undisputed dinosaur fossils date to about 233 Ma; possible earlier forms push the origin back towards 243 Ma.
